Questions

Before you save your seat

Who is this masterclass for?

Women, and especially ADHD women, who feel like food is on their mind all the time and want a calmer, simpler way to think about it.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. Everyone who signs up gets the replay.

Is this a diet?

No. There are no meal plans to follow and no weight-loss promises. It’s about understanding food noise and making food feel simpler.

Is this medical advice?

No. It’s an educational class with a nutrition coach. It isn’t medical advice or treatment, and it doesn’t replace support from your GP or another qualified professional.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-to-camera scripts, each around 30 to 45 seconds, in your own voice.

Script 1 · “Not willpower”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Food noise isn’t a willpower problem. Here’s what I mean.”

Body

“Food noise is that constant chatter about food: what’s next, what you shouldn’t have, what you’ll have later. Many ADHD women describe it as almost always on. After decades of dieting, I learned that a stricter plan rarely turns it down.”

CTA

“I’m running a free masterclass called Turn Down the Food Noise. Tap Sign up to save your seat. The replay is included.”

Shot: close-up talking to camera, lime top, warm café or kitchen setting.

Script 2 · “By Wednesday”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why do so many meal plans fall apart by Wednesday?”

Body

“For a lot of ADHD women, a rigid plan is just one more thing to get bored of. What tends to work better is small: around 10 minutes a day, with room to miss a day and simply catch up.”

CTA

“I’ll show you the approach in my free masterclass. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “by Wednesday” in Fraunces italic on a lime highlight.

Script 3 · “Volume dial”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If food noise had a volume dial, where would it sit today?”

Body

“In the Food Noise Reset, one of the first things we do is give food noise a score on day one, then check in every week. Noticing the number is the first step to understanding when it gets loudest.”

CTA

“Join my free masterclass, Turn Down the Food Noise. Forty-five minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, a 1 to 10 dial graphic animates on screen.

Educational content, not medical advice. No weight-loss or treatment claims.
